name: Hitesh Vishwakarma
headline: I connect product strategy, business operations and technology.
descriptor: Product & Business Operations | Product Strategy | Analytics
location: Bengaluru, India · Open to Remote India
summary: A product and business operations professional with 6+ years of experience across payments and financial services. I connect customer problems, operational systems, data and technology to improve journeys, controls and business execution.

metrics.label: Faster payment response / resolution
metrics.note: Six Sigma improvement across India, UK and US operations

career.summary: Started close to the customer, resolving UPI and payment issues and learning where transaction journeys break down.
details: Investigated UPI transaction failures, incorrect transaction status, refund and reversal delays, and complex payment escalations.
Improved troubleshooting steps, case prioritisation and escalation handling.
Contributed to process improvements associated with a 25% reduction in resolution time.

career.summary: Moved from case resolution into complex investigations, process improvement and team guidance across global payment operations.
details: Investigated payment failures, fraud patterns, high-value disputes and complex customer escalations.
Served as an interim Subject Matter Expert, guiding associates on complex cases, quality and process knowledge.
Managed 6–10 direct reports for 6–12 months, including coaching, quality reviews, work allocation, KPI monitoring and performance support.
Applied Six Sigma DMAIC to payment resolution workflows, contributing to 30% faster response and resolution across India, UK and US operations.
Recognised as a top performer for eight consecutive quarters.

career.summary: Moved closer to product execution, coordinating launches and improving workflows across fixed-income products and financial operations.
details: Supported bonds, Bond SIPs, FDs and RDs across launch readiness, pricing, inventory, repayments and record dates.
Coordinated UAT, data validation, platform readiness and issue resolution with Product, Engineering, Business Operations, Finance and Compliance.
Contributed to KYC workflow improvements associated with 45% fewer verification errors and 30% faster onboarding.
Designed and coordinated automation across repayment schedules, record dates and FD rate updates, reducing manual tracking effort by 70–80%.
Supported 60–70+ bond launches monthly for 10 months and 70+ live bond listings in daily operations.
Worked during a period when platform monthly transaction volume scaled from approximately ₹50 Cr to ₹800+ Cr. This is platform growth, not an individual attribution.
career.metricLabel: platform monthly transaction volume during tenure

projects.title: KYC verification & onboarding
projects.problem: Manual verification and repeated checks created avoidable errors and slowed onboarding.
projects.role: Managed testing, monitoring and process improvements around the verification workflow.
projects.approach: Reviewed verification outcomes, monitored failure patterns, supported workflow validation and helped close process gaps.
projects.caveat: The metrics describe workflow improvements supported by the user. Do not imply sole authorship of the automation.

projects.title: Repayment & financial-event monitoring
projects.problem: Tracking repayments, record dates and FD rate updates across sources required repeated manual checks.
projects.role: Combined process design, implementation coordination, testing, validation and monitoring.
projects.approach: Metabase data → Google Sheets → Apps Script → Slack alerts. Validations covered principal, interest, TDS on interest, net payout, ISIN-wise aggregation and reconciliation. Exceptions were flagged for manual correction.
outcome: Typical monitoring effort reduced from around 1–2 hours to 15–30 minutes
projects.caveat: Time ranges are approximate reported observations and are not used to calculate the percentage.

projects.title: Inventory visibility & controls
projects.problem: Manual tracking made low, excess and mismatched inventory harder to identify quickly.
projects.role: Personally built the workflow automation and reviewed/approved recommended adjustments.
projects.approach: Automated calculations, threshold checks, mismatch detection, data updates and scheduled reports across Sheets, Excel and internal exports. Final inventory decisions remained manual.
outcome: Automated low-stock, excess-stock and mismatch flags
projects.caveat: The approximately 60% reduction in manual effort was measured collectively across three workflows, not inventory alone.

projects.title: Bond launch & product readiness
projects.problem: Every launch depended on accurate pricing, returns, dates, documents, inventory and platform readiness.
projects.role: End-to-end launch coordination, operational validation and cross-team readiness tracking.
projects.approach: Validated pricing/yield, maturity details, documentation, inventory, approvals, UAT outcomes, defects and post-launch issues with Product, Engineering, Business Operations, Finance and Compliance.
outcome: 70+ live bond listings supported in daily operations

projects.title: Brokerage & pricing governance
projects.problem: Pricing changes required accurate values, effective dates, approvals and post-change checks.
projects.role: Coordinated stakeholder approvals and operational validation.
projects.approach: Maintained pricing and referral sheets, verified values and effective dates, tracked versions, checked customer/transaction impact and validated implemented changes.
outcome: More controlled pricing updates and traceable change handling
projects.caveat: Position as pricing governance and execution, not independent ownership of pricing strategy.

projects.title: Risk, fraud & transaction monitoring
projects.problem: Payment and financial workflows required timely investigation of suspicious patterns, failures and high-value disputes.
projects.role: Investigation, monitoring, analysis, escalation and operational coordination.
projects.approach: Reviewed transaction patterns, AML/KYC checks, exceptions and case evidence using internal tools, spreadsheets, SQL/database queries and dashboards.
outcome: Improved investigation, escalation and operational control practices

projects.title: Six Sigma process improvement
projects.problem: Payment response and resolution workflows had bottlenecks and avoidable handoffs.
projects.role: Contributed across DMAIC problem definition, measurement, root-cause analysis, improvement and monitoring.
projects.approach: Identified bottlenecks, standardised workflows and escalation paths, improved case prioritisation and monitored operational performance.
outcome: 30% faster response and resolution across India, UK and US payment operations

projects.title: Incident management & root-cause analysis
projects.problem: Production issues could affect customer outcomes and recur without clear root-cause closure.
projects.role: Investigation, impact assessment, Engineering coordination, fix validation and preventive controls.
projects.approach: Assessed scope, escalated critical incidents, tracked fixes, retested outcomes and documented corrective actions.
outcome: Improved issue resolution, production monitoring and prevention of recurring issues
